notes: First NEXA Agent release: NEXA 3.8.0 with its own Node 22 runtime, installed with one command on macOS, Linux or Windows (preview), no npm or Node needed. NEXA 3.8.0 runs TUI sub-agents in parallel, with git worktree isolation for writing children and builtin `reviewer` and `worker` agents, makes the first TUI turn faster and adds the `prr`, `nexa-audit-readiness`, `pr-review` and `synca-playbook` skills.
